manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve the Sanko disclosure-page publication-lag case where the visible confirmation form is still the latest public old-year PDF.
steps: Start from the Saitama official-index URL registered as https://www.sanko.ac.jp/disclosure/omiya-child/.
Inspect the disclosure page's 修学支援新制度 / 確認申請書 area before SERP fallback.
Observe that the latest target-form candidate is yoshiki2025.pdf with anchor text 2025年度.
Reject the PDF from strict FY2026 success as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025.
Keep the school in publication-lag/operator-reviewable status instead of counting it as crawler failure.

reusable_rules: Treat 2025年度/yoshiki2025.pdf as latest-public target-form evidence, not as FY2026 success.
Use official-index SchoolSite URLs first and preserve the rejection evidence for operator publication-lag review.
Do not let adjacent disclosure PDFs such as director compensation, school evaluation, syllabus, or security-policy files enter the target parser.
anti_patterns: Do not infer FY2026 from the current system target year when the actual link says 2025年度.
Do not accept stale forms just to improve the strict auto-yield metric.
Do not treat non-target disclosure PDFs on the same Sanko page as confirmation-form candidates.

evidence.notes: Windows v320 bounded Saitama bootstrap crawled this official-index disclosure page, found yoshiki2025.pdf, and rejected it as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025 for target FY2026.
